name: crios
description: Work with Crios projects, build sessions, workflows, and connectors from Cursor.

CRIOS_BASE_URL.title: Crios base URL
CRIOS_BASE_URL.description: REST API origin for the bundled client. Defaults to https://api.crios.ai. The client calls /api/v1 on that origin. This does not change the hosted MCP server at https://mcp.crios.ai/mcp. Do not include a token in the URL.

CRIOS_TOKEN.title: Crios personal access token
CRIOS_TOKEN.description: Personal access token from Crios Settings → API tokens. Set it here in Plugins → Configure. It starts with crios_pat_. Cursor sends it as the Authorization bearer header to https://mcp.crios.ai/mcp. A full-access token is required for workflows.
